description_expanded:
Seaside!

Access to all Seaside amenities (swim, tennis, & fitness!)

Pet friendly!

5 complimentary bikes

4th-floor crow’s nest & rooftop balcony

Open kitchen, dining, and living area

4 bedrooms (including 2 bunk rooms), plus a crow's nest nook, 5 full baths

2 laundry closets

Gas grill and expansive outdoor seating

​​The Poppy House by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Four floors, one rooftop, and only 0.2 miles from private beach access, welcome to The Poppy House, just a five-minute walk to the sand. The home rewards people who like unique spaces, and lots of them: quiet corners for reading, open spaces for belly laughs, and a crow's nest at the top for the moments that call for a view, which is pretty much all of them. That fourth-floor perch tends to become everyone's favorite spot (the community pools are the exception?). Reach it via the spiral staircase, settle onto the twin daybed, or step out onto the rooftop balcony. The seating is generous, the gulf views are wide, and the only debate is- oh, wait a sec, no debates up here, just viewing. The layout across the lower three floors gives every guest somewhere to land. The first floor works as its own wing: a guest room with a king bed, a secondary living area with a triple bunk and queen sleeper sofa, and a sun-lit window nook, perfect for a book or a slow afternoon. The second floor is where the house opens up.

A connected living, dining, and kitchen area spills out onto a large balcony with a gas grill and plenty of outdoor seating. Well-suited to a seafood dinner or a long, morning coffee. The third floor handles the rest. A primary suite with a walk-in shower, double vanity, and a proper walk-in closet. A dedicated bunk room so the kids have their own territory. A second laundry area, because, well, laundry. It happens, even on vacation. The Oversee 30A team is nearby every day, with a 24/7 line if anything needs attention. The Poppy House is ready when you are. Overview: - .2 of a mile or a 5-minute stroll to the beach (Savannah Pavillion Access) - Access to Seaside community pools and fitness center - Dogs considered, an additional $210 non-refundable fee for each pet (must be less than 50 Ibs) - 5 complimentary bikes - 2 living areas - 2 laundry closets - Rooftop balcony and crow's nest - Gas grill - Wi-Fi Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room: king bed, private bathroom, shower only, TV - Living Room: queen sofa bed, twin size triple bunk, TV - Full bathroom: shower/tub combo SECOND FLOOR - Guest Room: king bed, shared full bathroom, shower/tub combo, TV THIRD FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: king bed, private bath, large walk-in shower, double vanities, large walk in closet, laundry room, TV - Bunkroom: one twin over twin bunk, TV - Full bathroom, shower only FOURTH FLOOR - Twin daybed Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
